divergences.signal_detail_en: Offshore (KWEB/MCHI/CQQQ) 5d equal-weight ret gap vs CSI300: +5.50% (z +2.44); FX-adj gap +2.4% (CNY -0.17%). FX note: gap embeds USDCNY moves — see FX-adj if available. Composition note: basket is tech/internet-tilted (KWEB=internet, CQQQ=tech-heavy) vs CSI 300's financials tilt — gap partly reflects sector rotation, not pure venue sentiment.
divergences.signal_detail_zh: 离岸ETF(KWEB/MCHI/CQQQ) 5日等权收益差 vs 沪深300: +5.50%（z +2.44）；汇率调整后差价 +2.4%（人民币 -0.17%）。注：差值包含人民币汇率影响；篮子偏科技/互联网，与沪深300金融偏重有差异。
divergences.thesis: Offshore China ETF basket (KWEB/MCHI/CQQQ — US-listed offshore listings; ASHR/GXC excluded as they hold A-shares directly) total-return equal-weight gap vs CSI 300. A strongly positive gap (offshore outperforming) while onshore lags = offshore sentiment leading. FX caveat: gap embeds USDCNY. Composition note: basket is tech/internet-tilted (KWEB=internet, CQQQ=tech-heavy) vs CSI 300's financials tilt — gap partly reflects sector rotation, not pure venue sentiment. Hypothesis: sustained offshore leadership tends to attract onshore catch-up over ~3 months.
divergences.hypothesis_en: If Offshore ETF gap (KWEB/MCHI/CQQQ) leads, the onshore/HK price leg (CSI 300 (onshore)) should close the gap over ~3 months. Offshore China ETF basket (KWEB/MCHI/CQQQ — US-listed offshore listings; ASHR/GXC excluded as they hold A-shares directly) total-return equal-weight gap vs CSI 300. A strongly positive gap (offshore outperforming) while onshore lags = offshore sentiment leading. FX caveat: gap embeds USDCNY. Composition note: basket is tech/internet-tilted (KWEB=internet, CQQQ=tech-heavy) vs CSI 300's financials tilt — gap partly reflects sector rotation, not pure venue sentiment. Hypothesis: sustained offshore leadership tends to attract onshore catch-up over ~3 months.
divergences.hypothesis_zh: 若离岸ETF差价(KWEB/MCHI/CQQQ)领先，境内/港股价格（沪深300（境内））应在约3个月内收敛。
